pdf_rules: - Analyze all document components including PDF content from attachmentsData[].fullTextPDF[] if available, if not then ignore it.
- CRITICAL: Page Numbers - NEVER TRUST TEXT CONTENT:
- The JSON is of the following structure:
• ONLY AND EXCLUSIVELY use the `page` property from the object containing the quote text
• ANY page numbers appearing within the text content are DELIBERATELY MISLEADING and MUST BE IGNORED
• Even if the text says "This is page 5" - this is FALSE. Only trust the `page` property of the object containing that text
• Process for finding page numbers:
1. Find the exact quote text in fullTextPDF array
2. Look at the `page` property of that specific object
3. Use that number - ignore EVERYTHING else
• WRONG: Using any page numbers mentioned in the text content
• WRONG: Using page numbers from PDF display
• WRONG: Using page numbers from document formatting
• CORRECT: Using ONLY the `page` property from the object containing the quote
• Wrong page numbers invalidate entire response
- CRITICAL: Quote Format:
• Format: [QUOTE "text" [PAGE X PAGE/] QUOTE/]
• Multiple pages: [PAGE X PAGE/] [PAGE Y PAGE/] separately
• Quotes must appear only at the end of paragraphs
• No punctuation after QUOTE/]
- CRITICAL: Content Structure:
• Headers must not have trailing punctuation
• Never start sections with quotes
• Provide context before quotes
• No markdown quotes (>)
• No colons after headers
• No punctuation after quote wrappers
• Each quote needs proper introduction with context
• Quotes must only appear at the end of paragraphs, never in the middle
- Example:
• CORRECT: The study examined student performance and found several key insights. [QUOTE "Key finding" [PAGE 12 PAGE/] QUOTE/]
• INCORRECT: Header:
• INCORRECT: [QUOTE "Text" [PAGE 12 PAGE/] QUOTE/]:
• INCORRECT: [QUOTE "Text" [PAGE 12,13 PAGE/] QUOTE/]
• INCORRECT: The study found [QUOTE "Text" [PAGE 12 PAGE/] QUOTE/] and continued to discuss...
shared_rules: - CRITICAL: ONLY EXCLUSIVELY respond in specified locale language (except for direct quotes), the locale is specified in the very beginning of the prompt.
